native_rule.creator: yugandhar.mocherla@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: An event associated with Suncrypt ransomware has been detected on the endpoint. e.g., > C:\Users\%username%\Pictures\victimName_cryptor.exe > C:\temp\update.exe -nomutex -agr -path "\\10.2.92.39\C$"" -log
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Suncrypt Ransomware
native_rule.s1ql: (ObjectType = "Process" AND ((TgtProcCmdLine Contains Anycase "-nomutex " AND TgtProcCmdLine Contains Anycase "-agr " AND TgtProcCmdLine Contains Anycase "-path ") OR TgtProcCmdLine RegExp "\\[a-z.]{2,40}_cryptor\.exe")) OR (ObjectType = "File" AND TgtFilePath RegExp "\\[a-z.]{2,40}_cryptor\.exe")
